# Synthetic HEVC compatibility matrix

Generated by `node tests/fixtures/hevc-compatibility/make.mjs` with Homebrew
FFmpeg9.0.1/libx265, not user media. All inputs are two seconds,160×96,10-bit,
with a mono440Hz AAC track. Product decoding/conversion is tested against the
shipped FFmpeg7.1.1; it needs no libx265 or zscale. The separate existing
`../stitcher-hevc-hvc1.mp4` supplies Main8/no-audio coverage.

| Input     | Content                                                | SHA256                                                           |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| sdr10.mp4 | Moving test pattern, BT.709                            | c8be633b4941b9bf514a35623a853fc1abf18bf16e71311cd1550c6fd5e1131c |
| pq10.mp4  | BT.2020/PQ neutral patches,10-bit codes64/509/723/940  | 7e39e0a1cd404f6d63a2346d676a3476b42bba50ebd160bab01264dc133504d5 |
| hlg10.mp4 | BT.2020/HLG neutral patches,10-bit codes64/721/940/940 | 9a745069e3d7b4e5230356e19fdc6a2cebb96c08d93484510f3985d29cf7deb1 |
| vfr10.mp4 | 30fps then15fps packet spacing                         | 5143e4e4f9bf9699d3d95010469cb779e7319a164420fc336adc3cee8e59ede0 |

The generator explicitly writes HEVC VUI transfer/primaries with hevc_metadata:
FFmpeg9/libx265 otherwise omitted those flags in this environment. Tests assert
real HDR pixel output against an independent BT.2100/Mobius/BT.709 reference,
not just the file's colour labels. Rotation/hev1/MOV variants are lossless
remuxes at test time, using input `-display_rotation` rather than deprecated
rotate metadata. The reference pixels are safely inside each constant patch.

These fixtures qualify common SDR/Main10/PQ/HLG base layers. They contain no
Dolby Vision enhancement layer; profile5/ICtCp and non-decodable/encrypted media
remain explicit unsupported input rather than being rendered with false colours.
